name: Campingplatz Erlensee
beschreibung: The campsite Campingplatz Erlensee is located in the quiet village of Schechen in the alpine foothills. Surrounded by dense woodland and rolling hills, it sits close to the picturesque Lake Erlensee, which invites leisurely strolls. The park provides well-maintained pitches for motorhomes, caravans, and tents, alongside clean sanitary facilities, a kiosk, and a communal room. Its peaceful atmosphere appeals to families and travellers seeking an authentic, affordable stay in nature.
